X restricts post thanking Mamata; CJP founder fears handle takedown

Abhijeet Dipke, founder of the organisation Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP), stated he would not be surprised if his X (formerly Twitter) handle is taken down by the government before October 10. This statement followed the restriction of a post on X where Dipke had thanked West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee. The exact reason for the post's restriction was not specified in the coverage.
